department: Biomedical Engineering Program (Price Faculty of Engineering)

deadline.value: International applicants: January 8 for Fall (September) entry (Winter March 15, Summer August 1); rolling review.
deadline.quote: International applicants Term Annual application deadline Fall (September) January 8 Winter (January) March 15 Summer (May) August 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for this field and the program page does not mention one.

supervisor.value: You must get tentative acceptance from a faculty advisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: Qualification for admission to the PhD in Biomedical Engineering program is contingent on first receiving tentative acceptance from a faculty advisor who will accept you into their research group.

funding.value: No guaranteed stipend is stated; BME members must have funded research programs that include funding for students.

entry_route.value: A master's degree in engineering, health sciences or science (or an MD) is normally required, plus first-year linear algebra, calculus and physics.
entry_route.quote: you must normally have completed a master's-level degree from a faculty of engineering, health sciences or science or a Doctor of Medicine (MD) from a recognized university
